messages.subject: Project Sable - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Rebecca, Daniel,

I'm pleased to confirm that completion of the purchase of Sable House, 40 Deansgate took place at 2.30pm today. The balance of the price has been paid, we hold the executed TR1 and title documents, and Calder Whitmore have given the undertaking to discharge the Clydesford Bank charge and provide the DS1.

Next steps on our side: file the SDLT return and pay £1,227,000 within 14 days; serve notices of assignment of the reversion on the four tenants; and apply to register the transfer at HM Land Registry. We'll also complete the assignment of the Northbridge rent deposit.

Congratulations on the acquisition.

Best,
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

---
This email and any attachments are confidential and may be legally privileged.
